name: Trimesh Mesh Voxelization & Texture Color Mapping
aliases: Voxel Density Field Generation from Mesh
definition: Voxelizes a mesh into a hollow grid and maps the mesh's vertex texture colors to the voxels using proximity queries.
summary: Trimesh Mesh Voxelization & Texture Color Mapping converts polygonal meshes into volumetric density fields by marking proximity voxels and directly mapping vertex colors via barycentric projection or nearest-neighbor queries.
